_about: Vault Watch entries, edited by hand when DE announces a vaulting or a Prime Resurgence lineup. Starred items that match get the red exclamation mark until 'until' passes. type: 'vaulting' or 'resurgence'. Match by item name in 'items' and/or by relic in 'relics'. 'id' must be unique (change it if you reuse an entry so the pulse comes back). Example: {"id": "vault-2026-12", "type": "vaulting", "items": ["Ash Prime", "Vectis Prime"], "until": "2026-12-10", "title": "Relics may be vaulted soon", "note": "DE announced these relics leave the drop tables with the next Prime Access."}. Varzia's current Prime Resurgence stock is detected automatically from the live feed, so it doesn't need an entry here.
